description: This Java class 'RateAssembler' processes JSON data to extract rate information, specifically parsing JSON objects and arrays to recover rate IDs, and retrieves corresponding Rate entities from the repository.

classes.name: RateAssembler
classes.description: A service class responsible for assembling Rate domain objects from parsed JSON data, primarily extracting rate IDs from JSON and retrieving Rate entities.

methods.name: fromParsedJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON element to extract Rate objects based on embedded IDs within a JSON array, handling possible absence of data and returning a list of Rate entities.
